source_note: 通过pi的无理测度证明级数收敛2
english_source_note: Proving Series Convergence via the Irrationality Measure of pi II
callout_id: 通过pi的无理测度证明级数收敛2#5
statement_en: Let $$a_n := (\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{3}\sin(n))^n$$. Then the sequence is dense in $$[0,1]$$.
callout_body: 令$a_n := (\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{3}\sin(n))^n$那么序列在$[0,1]$当中稠密。
